snapshot_note: THE COMPILER KNOWS THE C LIBRARY'S SIGNATURES — v0.86.0 (session #105, 2026-08-19), three arcs, each a measured silent wrong answer. (1) LIBC FALLBACK: an UNDECLARED dlsym-resolved call was declared `long long f()`, so strcmp(a,b)<0 was FALSE (int -1 read out of all of rax) and floor(2.7) was 1.0 (a double read out of rax, not xmm0) — legal C89, exit 0, invisible to 1084 green tests because every caller includes the header and libstdc++ funnels its own __builtin_memcmp through an int. Fix at the one owner (dynamic_symbol_fallback_return_type/_signature, src/parser.cpp): default = C's own `int` (what the sibling C89 implicit path already built), every non-int return in ONE table — include/libc_signatures.h + src/libc_signatures.cpp, gcc's builtins.def model — and the 56 C99 math roots moved there so the lexer's __builtin_ alias map and the parser expand the SAME list (six roots had been hand-registered, one bug report each, while fifty read the wrong register). Part 2, ARGUMENTS: zero declared params = the variadic convention, so float promotion made floorf(3.9f)=2.000 and fmodf(7,4)=-nan; the table carries the NINE argument shapes (LibcArgs), resolved by ONE suffix-rule owner (math_family_of) so return and arguments cannot disagree about a family. Two DELIBERATE gcc divergences documented in testlibcnoheader.mad: gcc has no atof/atoll builtin entry and its own headerless output is UB garbage; madc prints the correct values. Gate: scripts/check-libc-alias-signatures.sh (fulltest) — every alias target must carry an entry, negative-controlled. Residual recorded in the plan doc: the c++locale.h pack-drain warning is an ARGUMENT-typing (typeof-declaration) defect at a different layer, NOT silenced by the locale entries (12 occurrences before and after — measured). (2) COUNT SEMANTICS (owner ruling 2026-08-18): containers count ELEMENTS, text kinds count LENGTH, null = empty container, anything else is a REAL madc exception (catch (const char *)) — never the silent 0 that `value s="hello"; s.count()` returned. Two questions, two functions: madarray_size stays the range-for BOUND untouched (object kind reads 0 there — pinned by the visited=0/count=2 test line); count/size bind to NEW madarray_count over ns_common::value_length. NEW src/rt/rt_except.h: the throw-family prototypes, included by rt_except.c so the first HOST caller of the exception runtime is compiler-checked (the rt_dump.h anti-mismatch model). std::string unchanged on purpose — .size()/.length() already answer, and a madc-only .count() on a real libstdc++ class would be the private-dialect divergence the getenv note rules out. (3) RANGE-FOR AUTO: `for (auto &kv : m)` / `for (auto x : v)` failed while the explicit-type forms worked — an ORDERING bug: TokenFOR::parse set elemtype/elemvar BEFORE the container parsed, so auto reached the body as the ddAUTO placeholder. Now: container parses FIRST ([stmt.ranged] — also fixes the shadowing divergence: `for (auto x : x)` binds the range to the OUTER array), then Program::range_for_deduce_element asks the SAME shared recognizers (their THIRD consumer): positional -> operator[]'s return, iterator -> ip.elem, raw array -> the element, madc array -> STRING (the #91 subscript ruling; NOT value — a value loop element does not compile, a loud recorded gap). class_iterator_iteration_protocol is now STATIC with an optional CirBuilder *abi carrying its one builder-state dependency (the __retbuf memo): codegen callers keep today's exact check, the parser passes NULL — a NULL-abi accept later declined still gets codegen's NAMED refusal. The reorder exposed the same shadow one layer down: translate_foreach_carray referenced the container BY NAME after the element declaration (int element = loud; POINTER element COMPILED and read garbage), fixed with a `prelude` channel — the range captured into a unique T *__fe_a_N BEFORE the element, typed by the ARRAY's element (never the loop element: `for (long e : int_arr)` must not stride 8 over 4-byte slots). CORRECTION banked: the earlier claim that `auto it = m.begin(); ++it` fails to parse was WRONG (re-measured at live HEAD, it works); and the 'all 68 __builtin_ registrations are dead' claim overstated — only three named rewritten spellings; the real gap was the fallback default.

known_pre_existing_gaps: SCRIPT `value` IS NOT YET THE 32-BYTE madc_value STRUCT (recorded 2026-08-17, owner: not to be taken on now). Symptom: `value f()` returned BY VALUE emits `int f()` and silently returns nothing (exit 0, empty output) — func_def's return-type arm -> type_list -> append_type_specs has no dtARRAY case and falls through to int. That is why php::print_r returns madc::value & rather than madc::value. CORRECTED PREMISE: a C type DOES exist — madc_value (include/madc_api.h:52) is a tagged 32-byte aligned(16) struct, and madc::value merely CONTAINS it plus two unique_ptr members (32+8+8 = 48 = the emitted long long[6]); the opaque-buffer lowering exists because of those OWNING C++ members, not a missing type. MEASURED: _array/_object are private with no friends and all 40 refs are in ONE file (src/madc_value.cpp) — 12 mutations, 28 reads; the cell finalizer is already wired and called from generated code (cir_builder.cpp:25789/25797); the is_array_object sites would mostly RETIRE. HARD PART: the class deep-copies the containers while the cell path shares, so the migration needs copy-on-write at those 12 sites — a semantic change with its own oracled tests. Full write-up: docs/plans/2026-06-12-type-table-value-abi-design.md section 9. Sibling defect, also open: assigning to a `value &` PARAMETER is wrongly rejected ('assignment of incompatible value').

VLA NOT DEALLOCATED ON BACKWARD GOTO: a `goto` jumping back to before a VLA's declaration must deallocate the VLA (gcc/C semantics; gcc-torture 20040811-1.c). madc lowers VLAs as malloc + __attribute__((cleanup)), which frees only on SCOPE EXIT, not on the backward goto re-entering the scope — so a backward-goto loop over a VLA LEAKS one allocation per iteration. 20040811-1.c leaks ~2GB over 1e6 iterations; it passes only when memory is available (it OOM-SIGSEGV'd when the MIR fork's 128MB code-holder reservation reduced headroom — see mir_fork; arch-gated off x86-64, so it passes again). Proper fix: free the VLA at the backward goto. Separate future slice.

MadArray/MadValue namespacing is an open API/ABI follow-up: moving the real C++ types to madc::array and madc::value would give PHP array helpers a normal namespace type surface, but compatibility aliases alone will not preserve old C++ mangled names.

Embedded <iostream> output remains partially staged: cout/cerr/clog still use header-defined stdio-backed ostream bodies. Follow-up is to replace that output surface with real libstdc++ declarations/operators, matching the std::cin direction; do not add stdio.h/FILE* stream bridges.
